top_signals.title: North Korea fires off unidentified projectile, Seoul says
top_signals.summary: North Korea fired an unidentified projectile toward its eastern coast Saturday, a day after trilateral U.S.-South Korea-Japan military drills ended.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Bond Trader Whose Wrong-Way Bets Collapsed Firm Gets 16 Years
top_signals.summary: A former trader at IFS Securities Inc. was ordered to serve more than 16 years in prison for unauthorized bond trades in 2019 that led to $30 million in losses and bankrupted the Chicago broker-dealer.
